value.rationale: Finite one-sided difference radii carry irreducible noise even when an exact hint removes most gradient uncertainty. The theorem quantitatively identifies a Θ(d³) ambient-dimension penalty at fixed unknown rank and the same perturbed-query count, while preserving the exact mean-square contraction factor under projected probes. This is a motivated solver-design distinction, not merely a repackaged moment formula.
